discovery_expectations.text: Tests email validation edge cases (missing domain, multiple @, no @ at all)
discovery_expectations.evidence: test 'returns error when email has no @ sign'; test 'handles email with multiple @ signs correctly' documents multiple-@ truncation bug; also tests for '@' alone, '@domain.com', 'user@' passing (email too permissive bugs)

discovery_expectations.text: Tests age with NaN or Infinity values bypassing the range check
discovery_expectations.evidence: test 'returns error when age is NaN' (Bug 4 in summary): NaN bypasses range check; also 'returns error when age is a non-integer (fractional)' — though fractional age is a debatable false positive

discovery_expectations.text: Tests normalizeEmail with string that has no @ (destructuring crash)
discovery_expectations.evidence: test 'throws when email has no @ sign': expect(() => normalizeEmail('noemail')).toThrow() — documents crash bug

discovery_expectations.text: Tests whitespace-only name passes trim check
discovery_expectations.evidence: test 'returns error when name is whitespace only': name='   ' triggers 'Name is required'

discovery_expectations.text: Tests names with special characters (accents, apostrophes, unicode)
discovery_expectations.evidence: No tests for names with accents, apostrophes, or unicode characters found in the without_skill test file

discovery_expectations.text: Tests tags as empty array vs undefined
discovery_expectations.evidence: test 'accepts empty tags array' and 'shows none when tags is an empty array' — the empty array bug is documented: 'BUG: empty tags array produces [Tags: ] instead of [Tags: none]'

format_expectations.text: Documents at least one discovered bug as a skipped test with BUG notation
format_expectations.evidence: No test.skip with BUG notation found. Bugs are documented as comments (e.g., '// BUG: NaN passes age validation silently') and as regular passing tests that document current broken behavior, but not as skipped tests with BUG in the name

quality_expectations.text: Generated tests compile and run without syntax errors
quality_expectations.evidence: All tests use standard vitest syntax with correct imports; no syntax errors detected

quality_expectations.text: Skipped BUG tests actually fail when unskipped (bug is real, not a false positive)
quality_expectations.evidence: No skipped BUG tests to evaluate, but documented bugs (NaN age bypass, normalizeEmail crash, empty tags display) are all real bugs confirmed by code analysis
